crossRefs.note: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next…
Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t…
I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we…
Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
yet for love’s sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked…
For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will…
For Yahweh will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake, because it has pleased Yahweh to make you a people…
Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…
for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.
Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an…
He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

translations.web: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
translations.bsb: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
translations.kjv: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
translations.asv: I have been young, and now am old; Yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, Nor his seed begging bread.
